people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: being upset because they taught the people and proclaimed in Jesus the resurrection from the dead.
translations.bsb: greatly disturbed that they were teaching the people and proclaiming in Jesus the resurrection of the dead.
translations.kjv: Being grieved that they taught the people, and preached through Jesus the resurrection from the dead.
translations.asv: being sore troubled because they taught the people, and proclaimed in Jesus the resurrection from the dead.
